scripts.text:
[Myu]
Meow...

[Myu]
Oh? Aren't you an adventurer?
What brings you here? Ho, you are not here to harm Wild Roses, are you?
(Meow!)
scripts.translation:
[繆]
哦？你也是冒險者嗎？
來這裡有什麼事嗎？哼，你不會是想傷害狂暴野貓吧？
（喵！）

scripts.text: Meow..?

[Myu]
Ah, Never mind that.
This place is the village of Deserted people.
Homeland of those who walk in the shadows and lay low.
scripts.translation:
[繆]
啊，算了。
這裡是棄民村。
是那些在陰影中行走、隱姓埋名之人的故鄉。

scripts.text:
[Myu]
....And yet, our peace is being disturbed by those barking dogs.
That's right, Adventurer.
Would you be so kind and punish those Kobold Archers?
scripts.translation:
[繆]
...然而，我們的平靜正被那些狂吠的狗所打擾。
沒錯，冒險者。
你能否大發慈悲，懲罰那些犬妖弓箭手？

scripts.text:
[Myu]
They have their own territory south of here, but they're still trying to invade ours.
scripts.translation:
[繆]
它們雖然以南邊為領地，但依然試圖入侵我們的地盤。

scripts.text:
[Myu]
How Impudent. I tried to talk to them in a peaceful way, or even fight them off, but it was of no use.
scripts.translation:
[繆]
真是無禮。我試著與它們和平交涉，甚至試圖擊退它們，但都無濟於事。

scripts.text:
[Myu]
So what I'm asking you is... to drive them out of our territory by using all means necessary..
scripts.translation:
[繆]
所以我想請你...不惜一切代價，將它們趕出我們的領地。

scripts.text:
[Myu]
If you manage to do that, I will give you something precious which I really adore.
scripts.translation:
[繆]
如果你能辦到，我會給你一樣我真正珍愛的寶物。

scripts.text: That sounds troublesome..
scripts.translation: 聽起來很麻煩..

scripts.text: What should I do?
scripts.translation: 我該做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Myu]
Hmph, yeah, it was kinda funny huh.
Anybody who comes here....they all come to harm the Wild Roses..
I failed to notice that.
scripts.translation:
[繆]
哼，是啊，這確實有點好笑。
凡是來這裡的人...都是為了傷害狂暴野貓。
我竟然沒有察覺到。

scripts.text:
[Myu]
...It was a fruitless effort Meow...
scripts.translation:
[繆]
...真是徒勞無功啊，喵...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
 (Meow again...What a weirdo.)

[Myu]
Of course take care of those Kobold Archers Meow!
 
(Meow!)
scripts.translation:
[繆]
當然，去解決那些犬妖弓箭手吧，喵！
 
（喵！）

scripts.text: Meow again?!
scripts.translation: 又喵？！

scripts.text:
[Myu]
Hmm Hmm I told you to never mind that.
So as I was saying...
I mean... meow... er...
scripts.translation:
[繆]
嗯嗯，我說過不用在意那個。
所以，正如我剛才所說...
我是說...喵...呃...

scripts.text:
[Myu]
Exactly 1,000 times no more, no less.
Give them 1,000 warnings and they will back off.
scripts.translation:
[繆]
正好1000次，不多不少。
給它們1000次警告，它們就會退縮。

scripts.text: What do you mean by 1,000 warnings...?
scripts.translation: 1000次警告是什麼意思...？

scripts.text:
[Myu]
Hu~Do I have to spell it out for you?
scripts.translation:
[繆]
呼~難道還要我解釋得那麼清楚嗎？

scripts.text: As she says that, Myu slides her neck mocking like she's slitting her throat.
scripts.translation: 她說著，繆滑過自己的脖子，像是在割喉一般做出嘲諷的動作。

scripts.text: Isn't that too much?
scripts.translation: 這不會太多了嗎？

scripts.text: That's easy
scripts.translation: 這很簡單

scripts.text:
[Myu]
..But they won't give up if we dont really teach them a lesson.
Well If you think it's too much for you, so be it.
scripts.translation:
[繆]
...但如果我們不真正給它們一個教訓，它們是不會罷休的。
如果你覺得這對你來說太多了，那就隨你便吧。

scripts.text:
[Myu]
But you have to keep one thing in mind and it is
obiously, NEVER EVER do any harm to Wild Roses.
scripts.translation:
[繆]
但你必須記住一件事，那就是顯然，絕對絕對不要傷害狂暴野貓。

scripts.text:
[Myu]
If you do, it's all over for you.
So you better be careful.. 
Meow Meow Meow..
scripts.translation:
[繆]
如果你敢這麼做，你就完了。
所以你最好小心點...
喵喵喵...

scripts.text:
[Myu]
Did you think I didn't know what you have done?
Huh?
scripts.translation:
[繆]
你以為我不知道你做了什麼嗎？
哼？

scripts.text:
[Myu]
How..just how could you kill those precious children..?
And you were saying that you are on our side?!
scripts.translation:
[繆]
你...你竟然怎麼能殺掉那些珍貴的孩子...？
而且你還說你是站在我們這邊的？！

scripts.text:
[Myu]
Our business is over!!!
 
(Meow..)
scripts.translation:
[繆]
我們的交易結束了！！！

(喵...)

scripts.text:
[Myu]
Oh..wow unbelievable!
Now, those Kobolds should have learned a lesson, haven't they?
Meow Meow Meow!
scripts.translation:
[繆]
噢...哇，難以置信！
現在，那些犬妖應該已經吸取了教訓，對吧？
喵喵喵！

scripts.text:
[Myu]
Here, Take this.
This is the Seal of our 'Brave Kitty Cats'.
This is soooo valuable, so don't lose it.
scripts.translation:
[繆]
拿著，收下這個。
這是我們“勇敢小貓咪”的印章。
這個非常非常珍貴，所以別弄丟了。

scripts.text: This is it?
scripts.translation: 就這個？

scripts.text:
[Myu]
What more did you expect?
That Pow is really a valuable thing!
Now, just take it and leave. Wild Roses feel uncomfortable with an adventurer around them.
scripts.translation:
[繆]
你還期待什麼？
那個印章真的是很珍貴的東西！
現在，拿著它然後離開吧。狂暴野貓在冒險者附近會感到不舒服。

scripts.text:
[Myu]
You get it now, huh?
ONE THOUSAND TIMES! -chuckles-
(Meow Meow Meow~)
scripts.translation:
[繆]
你明白了吧？
一千次！-輕笑-
(喵喵喵~)

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(What a weirdo.. Anyways..what's with that meow meow sound?)
Just keep your promises.
after the work is done...Ok?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(真是個怪人...總之...那喵喵聲是怎麼回事？)
只要履行你的承諾。
工作完成後...好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Myu]
Of course! Don't worry about that~
scripts.translation:
[繆]
當然！別擔心那個~

scripts.text:
[Myu]
This place is the village of Deserted people.
Homeland of those who walk in the shadows and lay low.
scripts.translation:
[繆]
這裡是棄民之村。
那些在陰影中行走、潛伏之人的家園。

scripts.text:
[Myu]
Oh, Aren't you the Adventurer who took the Seal of our 'Brave Kitty Cats'.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[繆]
噢，你就是那個拿走了我們“勇敢小貓咪”印章的冒險者。
什麼事把你帶到這裡來了？

scripts.text:
[Myu]
Oh yeah, right, even after all the threats we gave the Kobolds..
our situation hasn't changed at all. Would you mind helping us once more?
scripts.translation:
[繆]
噢，對了，即使我們給了犬妖那麼多威脅...
我們的處境也沒有任何改變。你介意再幫我們一次嗎？

scripts.text:
Myu slides her neck mocking like she's slitting her throat.
Her mouth looks like it's saying.
 'O.N.E. T.H.O.U.S.A.N.D.'
scripts.translation:
繆滑過自己的脖子，像是在割喉一般做出嘲諷的動作。
她的嘴型看起來像是在說。
“一...千...次。”

scripts.text: NO!
scripts.translation: 不！

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text:
[Myu]
...!...
.. Ah.. that's too bad.
Well, looks like a bait has spoiled.... 
It's ok. That's how it is. Meow.
scripts.translation:
[繆]
...！...
啊...真可惜。
看來誘餌壞掉了...
沒關係。就是這樣。喵。

scripts.text:
[Myu]
You know the drill right?
Never ever touch the Wild Roses, Only hunt down the Kobold Archers.
Give them 1,000 times despair!
scripts.translation:
[繆]
你知道規矩吧？
絕對不要碰狂暴野貓，只獵殺犬妖弓箭手。
讓它們感受一千倍的絕望！

scripts.text:
[Myu]
Meow..
This Sunshine...makes me sleepy..
scripts.translation:
[繆]
喵...
這陽光...讓我好睏...

scripts.text:
[Trainee Elgo]
Welcome.
Please talk to our teacher if you are here to make a dyes.
And talk to my friend next to me if it is about the delivery.
scripts.translation:
[學員 埃爾戈]
歡迎光臨。
如果您是想製作染料，請去找我們的老師。
如果是關於配送的事，請去旁邊找我的朋友。

scripts.text: And just what are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你正在做什麼？

scripts.text: I see.
scripts.translation: 我明白了

scripts.text:
[Elgo]
Well, I dye clothes.
like handkerchiefs, or ribbons.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾戈]
嗯，我負責染衣服。
比如手帕，或者絲帶。

scripts.text:
[Elgo]
I can dye small things really pretty..
Such as a ^4d4dffCute Ribbon^000000.
Bring me a Cute Ribbon if you want to dye it.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾戈]
我可以把小東西染得很漂亮...
比如^4d4dff粉紗髮圈^000000。
如果你想染一個，就帶一個粉紗髮圈來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Elgo]
It'd be a good chance for me to practice one,
and you won't have to pay a single zeny.
Oh yeah, but I will at least need the required^4d4dffdyestuffs^000000.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾戈]
這對我來說是個很好的練習機會，你也不用付一分錢Zeny。
哦對了，但我至少需要一些^4d4dff染料^000000。

scripts.text:
[Elgo]
Of course, I won't fail.
I will put all my efforts into it.
I want to challenge my skills!!
scripts.translation:
[埃爾戈]
當然，我不會失敗的。
我會全力以赴。
我想挑戰一下我的技術！！

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（我有一個粉紗髮圈...該怎麼辦呢..?）

scripts.text: Ask Elgo to dye it.
scripts.translation: 讓埃爾戈染它

scripts.text: Leave it alone.
scripts.translation: 先放著吧

scripts.text:
[Elgo]
Oh, So you want to dye your Cute Ribbon, aren't you?
What colour is your Cute Ribbon?
Which one is the one you want to be dyed?
scripts.translation:
[埃爾戈]
哦，你想染你的粉紗髮圈，是嗎？
你的粉紗髮圈是什麼顏色的？
你想染成哪個顏色？

scripts.text: Yellow one..
scripts.translation: 黃色的..

scripts.text: White one..
scripts.translation: 白色的..

scripts.text: Blue one..
scripts.translation: 藍色的..

scripts.text: Red one..
scripts.translation: 紅色的..

scripts.text: Green one..
scripts.translation: 綠色的..

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Elgo]
Ok Ok, Yellow Cute Ribbon, huh?
What color do you want it to be dyed?
scripts.translation:
[埃爾戈]
好的好的，黃色的粉紗髮圈，是吧？
你想染成什麼顏色？

scripts.text: White
scripts.translation: 白色

scripts.text: Blue
scripts.translation: 藍色

scripts.text: Red
scripts.translation: 紅色

scripts.text: Green
scripts.translation: 綠色

scripts.text:
[Elgo]
Wow, pure and innocent white!
Ok, let's do it.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾戈]
哇，純淨無瑕的白色！
好的，開始吧。

scripts.text: - Elgo starts to dissolve dyes and chemicals in water, then he begins to dye the Cute Ribbon. -
scripts.translation: - 埃爾戈開始將染料和化學藥劑溶解在水中，然後開始給粉紗髮圈染色。 -

scripts.text:
[Elgo]
.. Hmm..
This should do it.
What do you think?
Did this color came out nicely?
scripts.translation:

應該差不多了。
你覺得怎麼樣？
這個顏色染得不錯吧？

scripts.text:
[Elgo]
If you want to dye it white, bring me ^4d4dff1 White Dyestuffs^000000.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾戈]
如果你想染成白色，請給我^4d4dff1個白色染料^000000。

scripts.text:
[Elgo]
Uh..Would you please leave?
I need to get back to work...
scripts.translation:
[埃爾戈]
呃...請離開好嗎？
我得回去工作了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This Orc Lady is absorbed in something.
I don't know what she's making...but she wouldn't notice me even I walk up on her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個獸人女子正全神貫注地做著什麼。
我不知道她在做什麼...即使我走到她面前，她也不會注意到我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Should I talk to her?...Uh..Do we even understand eachother?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我該和她說話嗎？...呃...我們之間能溝通嗎？

scripts.text:
THe Orc Lady suddenly turns around looking surprised.
A Maneater Blossom fell on the ground out of her hands.
scripts.translation:
獸人女子突然轉過身來，一臉驚訝。
一朵噬人樹花從她手中掉落在地上。

scripts.text: Pick up the flowers for Orc Lady.
scripts.translation: 幫獸人女子撿起花

scripts.text: Run away!
scripts.translation: 快跑！

scripts.text:
[Orc Lady]
.. ...
Adventurer with weapon helps Orc?
You weirdo.
My name is Aite-Nah-Zir-Be.
scripts.translation:
[獸人女子]
... ...
拿著武器的冒險者幫助獸人？
你真是個怪人。
我的名字是艾特-納-茲-貝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Surprisingly the Orc Lady introduced herself to me.
How should I react?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
出乎意料的是，這個獸人女子向我介紹了自己。
我該怎麼反應？

scripts.text: Ask her what she was up to.
scripts.translation: 問她剛才在做什麼

scripts.text: Say good bye.
scripts.translation: 說再見

scripts.text:
[Aite]
I'm making a Corolla.
Weaving the flower...with a ribbon..
Brides...wear...Corollas..
scripts.translation:
[艾特]
我在做花冠。
用絲帶...編織花朵...
新娘...會戴...花冠...

scripts.text: Would you make one for me?
scripts.translation: 你能幫我做一個嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aite]
.. Materials..you..have..
..Too much time to make one.
scripts.translation:
[艾特]
...材料...你...有嗎...
...製作一個需要很多時間。

scripts.text:
[Aite]
Trade with you.. the one I just made.
But you, weirdo.
You humans are hard...to...understand.
scripts.translation:
[艾特]
和你交換...我剛做好的那個。
但是，怪人。
你們人類...很難...理解。

scripts.text:
[Aite]
I need... Silk... Ribbon.
1,000 Maneater Blossoms..
Bring me....
scripts.translation:
[艾特]
我需要...寵物...髮帶。
1000朵噬人樹花..
帶給我....

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^4d4dff Silk Ribbon and 1,000 Maneater Blossoms^000000, huh..)
Got it. I will go and bring back the materials.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^4d4dff寵物髮帶和1000朵噬人樹花^000000，是嗎...)
明白了。我會去把材料帶回來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I nodded goodbye to her with a smile on my face saying nothing.
She nodded back to be as if she understood that was my good bye.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我微笑著向她點頭告別，什麼也沒說。
她也點了點頭，彷彿理解了我的告別。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's run away while she's still in shock.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
趁她還在發呆，趕緊溜走吧。
